[roadway] roadway not divided (traffic east to west). unit 1 was traveling southbound on 600 queretaro coming to the intersection of queretaro and oveja. unit 1 then conducted a left turn to travel eastbound onto oveja. pedestrian (aldo ingram) and his mother (minarva robles) were walking on the east sidewalk of 600 queretaro southbound coming to the intersection of queretaro and oveja. pedestrians began to cross southbound across oveja to continue on queretaro. driver of unit 1 stated she did not see the pedestrians until the last second and stopped the vehicle. driver of unit 1 was adamant that she did not hit either pedestrians, however, pedestrian aldo became upset and slammed his hand down on the driver side of her hood. pedestrian aldo advised unit 1 hit him on his right torso area, but did not fall down. pedestrian aldo then pushed his hand against the hood of unit 1 to push himself away from the vehicle. pedestrian aldo stated he did not want to press charges and only wanted a report. pedestrian minarva advised she saw the vehicle coming and ran away. she did not see the impact between unit 1 and pedestrian aldo and only heard a thump. officers observed a crack in the front driver side headlight. owner of unit 1 showed a picture taken in march of 2023 of the listed damage showing it was prior to this incident. officers observed no further damage to unit 1. pedestrian aldo showed his right side torso that he said was hurt, and officers did not observe any visible injuries. officers checked the intersection and were unable to locate any potential video cameras from the adjacent houses. due to conflicting stories no party was cited. pedestrian aldo refused medical assistance and would be checked out at a later time.

[roadway] stopped. however, [roadway] [roadway]. an unidentified red pickup truck did not stop and the left side tail end of the extended cab struck kwasniak. the red pickup truck did not stop and fled the scene. it was advised by plano pd off-duty officer hess that there was video of the incident captured by the intersection cameras and it showed what appeared to be a red nissan titan pickup truck as the suspect vehicle. however, the video was unable to capture a license plate or physical description of the driver. i was advised by officer sneed (#1943) that other witnesses at the scene advised observing the same thing, but did not want to provide their identification information. at this time kwasniaks parents (identified as kawsniak, terence anthony, w/m, [date], txdl: 07830401 & kwasniak, kathryn gail, w/f, [date], txdl: 10214703) arrived on scene and were advised on what happened. kwasniak was [medical facility] (mcp) for further evaluation. upon arrival at mcp, kawsniak was stabilized and was in good condition. terence and kathryn were provided with as yellow service card containing the incident number to this report. due to the totality of the circumstances and information gathered, i concluded the offense of collision involving personal injury (failure to leave identification/accident causing injury) occurred when the unidentified driver of a possible red nissan tundra, struck kwasniak and failed to stop in a collision involving injury to another. video of the incident was forwarded to pddigitalmedia@plano. gov for evidence. this report was also forwarded to the plano pd traffic unit for further follow-up. a crash report was also generated along with this offense report. nothing further at this time.

(3900 block), plano, collin county, texas. call notes indicated a red pickup heading s/[roadway] had struck a pedestrian (identified as kwasniak, matthew terence, w/m, [date], txdl: 33905461) and fled the scene. call notes further indicated kwasniak stood up and stumbled into the parking lot of christ united methodist church located at [roadway] (south west corner of the intersection). i arrived on scene and made contact [roadway] rash and what appeared to be a cut/abrasion to the right side of his cheek/mouth area. it was apparent that kwasniak had down syndrome, but was talking ok and was able to tell [roadway] to head to this church. kwasniak further advised his father was playing basketball at the church, but had gone to a whataburger. at this time plano fd arrived on scene and began to give medical aid to kwasniak. plano fd firefighter bennett (bennett, matthew william, w/m, [date], txdl: 22924826) advised he observed kwasniak attempting to cross the crosswalk from the se corner to the s/w corner of the intersection (in a westerly direction). s/[roadway] had a green light. kwasniak made it to the median before he [roadway] (s/b traffic). [roadway] stopped. however, [roadway] [roadway]. an unidentified red pickup truck did not stop and the left side tail end of the extended cab struck kwasniak. the red pickup truck did not stop and fled the scene. it was advised by plano pd off-duty officer hess that there was video of the incident captured by the intersection cameras and it showed what appeared to be a red nissan titan pickup truck as the suspect vehicle. however, the video was unable to capture a license plate or physical description of the driver. i was advised by officer sneed (#1943) that other witnesses at the scene advised observing the same thing, but did not want to provide their identification information. at this time kwasniaks parents (identified as kawsniak, terence anthony, w/m, [date], txdl: 07830401 & kwasniak, kathryn gail, w/f, [date], txdl: 10214703) arrived on scene and were advised on what happened. kwasniak was [medical facility] (mcp) for further evaluation. upon arrival at mcp, kawsniak was stabilized and was in good condition. terence and kathryn were provided with as yellow service card containing the incident number to this report. due to the totality of the circumstances and information gathered, i concluded the offense of collision involving personal injury (failure to leave identification/accident causing injury) occurred when the unidentified driver of a possible red nissan tundra, struck kwasniak and failed to stop in a collision involving injury to another. video of the incident was forwarded to pddigitalmedia@plano. gov for evidence. this report was also forwarded to the plano pd traffic unit for further follow-up. a crash report was also generated along with this offense report. nothing further at this time.
